categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Labeled P2P and modifies connection management logic in src/net.cpp and src/net.h.
categories.rationale: Prevents redundant outgoing connections caused by concurrent manual connection attempts racing before handshakes finish. As described in the PR, '-connect and -addnode can attempt the same manual connection concurrently during startup', racing past duplicate checks that only inspect peers already published to m_nodes. While it addresses a long-standing issue (#5299), duplicate manual dialing is an edge case with minor operational impact.
